definitions.short: filth , i.e. (figuratively and specifically) an idolatrous object
definitions.full: H8263. sheqets שֶׁ֫קֶץ noun masculine Lev 7:21 detestation, detestable thing ; — ׳שׁ of the ceremonially unclean. 7:21 ; creatures forbidden as food: water animals without fins or scales 11:10-11 , 12 , birds of prey, etc., 11:13 , winged creeping things 11:20 ; 11:23 , creeping vermin 11:41 ; 11:42 (all P), compare Isa 66:17 (+ הָעַכְבָּר הַחֲזִיר, בְּשַׂר ); see RS Semitic i. 275, 2nd ed. 293; K 309 f., 2nd ed. 311 f. — Ezek 8:10 read probably שִׁקּוּצִים , see שִׁקּוּץ .
